newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil surges at close ahead of PORLA.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil surges at close ahead of PORLA.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Sept (3rd pos) 1,144 rgt/tonne July (south) 1,185
Open/Hi/Low 1,132/1,145/1,132 Prev close 1,165
Prev settlement 1,128 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices surged strongly at the close after covering and speculative interest emerged on firmer cash markets, ahead of PORLA data. Technical buying came after September futures rose over 1,130 rgt, and was expected to move between 1,120 and 1,150. A crop report from private forecaster Ivan Wong had no impact.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Business in nearby CPOS and products.
"Well, the data should be within market expectations. But then again you never know, PORLA may give surprises," added the trader.
A crop report by private crop forecaster Ivan Wong had no impact on the market, said traders.
Released on Monday, Wong estimated Malaysia's palm oil output in June at 788,000 tonnes versus 790,640 in May.
Wong last projected June output at 785,000 tonnes.
He put palm oil stocks at end of June at 795,000 tonnes, compared with the 711,841 tonnes calculated by the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority in May.
Wong also estimated exports in June at 595,000 tonnes against the 626,606 tonnes exported in May.
A technical analyst said technical buying emerged after third month September futures rose above 1,130 ringgit.

He expects the contract to rise further if Chicago soyoil futures moved up overnight. September futures ended the day 16 ringgit higher at 1,144 ringgit ($451.99) a tonne after drifting between 1,132 and 1,145 ringgit.
Turnover on the futures market was 1,422 lots traded.
The physical market saw some refiners' covering and buying with low prices attracting products buying.
Among physicals saw July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,185 ringgit against bids at 1,182.50 after trading at 1,175 and 1,182.50.
July (central) saw offers at 1,175 ringgit versus 1,172.50.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,185 against bids of 1,182.50 with earlier trades done at 1,175 and 1,182.50.
Aug (central) was offered at 1,175 against bids of 1,172.50 after trading at 1,162.50 and 1,170.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $495 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug at $490 and Sept/Dec at $490.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $532.50, Aug/Sept at $530, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $527.50. Aug was traded at $527.
July RBD palm stearin was offered at $380 and Aug/Sept palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $292.50.
